# Figpal reference artwork

The original vector portraits in org-chart.svg use Figma's FigPal character types as visual references. Employee names, job titles and the organization are fictional game content.

- Figma, “Finding a forever home for FigPals”: https://www.figma.com/blog/finding-a-forever-home-for-figpals/
- Official character sheet: https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/84edb5acea7d705011570f32d2ec17413a406bd7-3840x2160.png
- Official sticker grid: https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/0b60bbba050c8f9dcec5d99d1a64ff0176f3fcdc-934x956.png
- Official creator interview: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/figma_the-lore-of-figpals-with-galaxia-wu-https-activity-7316612246661468160-yk7c

Documents are generated with scripts/create-wall-art.mjs. In-room textures use a limited resolution. Inspection displays the same SVG at full vector resolution.
